conventions.span: right-continuous; at the domain end the last non-empty span (REQ-GEO.NURBS.EVAL-006)
conventions.domain: [U[p], U[n]] for n control points; outside by more than 1e-14 x width is outside_domain, within it clamps (REQ-GEO.NURBS.EVAL-002)
conventions.surface_net: row-major: control point (i, j) at i * n_v + j
conventions.domain_checks: t just outside an end: outside_domain (1e-6 x width out) or clamp (0.25e-14 x width out, evaluates as the end); for surfaces the other parameter is at its domain start
conventions.derivatives: exact rational, rounded once; surfaces su, sv, suu, suv, svv; curves d1, d2
conventions.normal: Su x Sv / |Su x Sv|; null when degenerate (|Su x Sv| < 1e-14 |Su||Sv| or a zero derivative)
conventions.curvature: signed against the normal, k = II/I, II = <S_xy, n>; k1 >= k2; gaussian k1 k2; mean (k1+k2)/2; curve curvature |C' x C''| / |C'|^3
conventions.inversion: global closest point on the untrimmed entity including its boundary; ties within 1e-15 m resolve to the lexicographically smallest parameters (REQ-GEO.NURBS.INVERT-004); alternatives lists other local minima within 1e-9 m; on_boundary is true exactly when a parameter equals a domain limit; every NURBS reference is certified global within 1e-15 m (exact Bernstein bound, tools/fixtures/nurbs_cert.py)
conventions.float: every f64 as {hex: binary64 bit pattern, dec: shortest round-trip decimal}
